exposure: gestational age at delivery (37, 38, and 39 weeks)
outcome: admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 4242 women who had an elective CD at term  between August 2008 and July 2012 in a single Irish maternity hospital
finding: Neonatal outcomes are better when elective caesarean delivery is performed at 39 weeks gestation compared to earlier gestational ages.
